items.title: Costco Wholesale (COST) Director Resigned After Winning Rhode Island Governor Race
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) director Helena B. Foulkes has resigned from the board after being elected governor of Rhode Island. The company stated that Foulkes' departure was not related to any disagreement with Costco Wholesale or its management. Her exit alters the board's long serving membership mix and opens a seat that the retailer may look to fill. Costco Wholesale's story extends well beyond Helena B.
